purpose: Evaluate a bounded transfer of already frozen heterogeneous-E1 NSESche profiles on the already revealed E713-E715 E3/E4 training cohort, without changing the utility, runtime, or binary.

mechanism.family: transfer of frozen heterogeneous-E1 operational profiles
mechanism.motivation: V89 showed that scenario-native initializers were frequently replaced by a paper-welfare surrogate that was weakly aligned with completion and QPR. V90 therefore tests mature, already compiled NSESche profiles that previously passed independent heterogeneous-E1 development gates, without adding a new formula or numeric hyperparameter.
mechanism.E3_candidate_selection_rule: For each E3 burst scenario independently, a candidate is eligible only when its E713-E715 arithmetic mean is strictly greater than the frozen V87 maximum advanced-baseline mean for throughput_requests_per_ms, qpr_finite_only, and qpr_zero_completed_as_zero. If both candidates are eligible, select the candidate with the larger minimum relative margin across the three metrics; an exact tie is resolved by lexicographically smaller candidate_id. If neither is eligible, the scenario fails.
mechanism.E4_candidate_selection_rule: The single frozen middle-load transfer candidate must strictly pass all three metrics; there is no within-E4 selection.

frozen_execution.reference_reuse_rule: Both E3 candidates share the same workload, topology, seed, immutable social-welfare state, and reference build specification. Reuse exactly the 12 hash-bound V89 reference entries; operational profile and variant do not enter the policy-independent reference key.

training_gate.per_scenario_rule: Apply the frozen candidate-selection rules; the selected candidate must strictly exceed the frozen V87 maximum advanced-baseline mean for all three metrics.
training_gate.joint_rule: All three E3 scenarios and E4 must pass before a separate V90 confirmation plan may be written.
training_gate.failure_action: Retain all 21 training runs and references, do not consume E716-E718, and return to mechanism diagnosis rather than selectively rerunning candidates.
training_gate.success_action: Freeze the scenario-specific selected profiles and existing binary without further tuning, preregister exactly E716-E718, then require a result-blind audit and one-time reveal for paper-group closure.
